visual_architecture_failure.reason: The decomposition was pixel-exact but violated the canonical layer stack. Body base must exist independently of clothing; hair must be a separate persistent secondary layer; clothing must be separate overlays; hidden body pixels under those occluders must exist before animation/damage systems can be valid.

operator_feedback: Do not bake clothing into body parts. Hair must be treated as its own piece/layer. Clothing pieces are overlaid on a complete body base.
